svg.title: Log first, certificate second
svg.desc: The subscriber asks the CA. The CA appends a log entry to its own issuance log, then signs subtrees of the log as a cosigner. Witnesses fetch the same entries, check them, and cosign the subtrees too. Only then does the CA build the certificate: the TBSCertificate, an inclusion proof to a subtree, and the cosignatures. Later, landmark subtrees are pushed to browsers, and certificates relative to them need no signatures.

text.tspan: CT logs a certificate after it exists; here the log entry exists before the certificate can be built.
